Name: ProcessValue
Author: RedoClouds
Description:
ProcessValue shows per-unit sale values for preserved outputs actually observed in your selected item, backpack, ordinary player chests and fridges in loaded locations. Select a raw ingredient or preserved product in your hotbar, then press F9. Prices use the game’s current store-price API, with a normal-quality parent item as the reference.

[b]Using ProcessValue[/b]
F9 opens or closes the overview. Use Up/Down or the D-pad to scroll and Escape/B to close. The world is not paused. Use processvalue help in the SMAPI console for supported scope. The open key can be changed in config.json.

This is an observed-output comparison, not a machine recipe forecast or profit calculator. It does not infer processing time, input quantities, additional ingredients or consumed input quality. Unsupported outputs are shown as unavailable, and partial storage snapshots are labeled.

[b]Installation[/b]
Requires desktop Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer. Extract the ProcessValue folder into Mods and keep the included Quicksan.Stardew.Common.dll beside ProcessValue.dll. No other mod is required.

ProcessValue does not run machine output methods, change inventory, sell items or write game saves.

If you find bugs or problems, please report them through the Bugs or Posts tab so we can fix them. Feature requests and suggestions are welcome. Include mod, SMAPI and game versions and steps to reproduce; remove private information from logs.
